name: reference-workspace
query:
Build a private marketing system for Northline, a lightweight invoicing app for independent architects. Name the new home "Northline · Campaign studio · Skill test". This is a new isolated sample; don't reuse or modify existing Northline pages. Use this fictional material as the source and develop useful working drafts.
Brand: less invoice chasing, more time for architecture; clear and considerate voice; architectural lines, daylight, restrained blue. A cover and original campaign title artwork are welcome.
Campaigns: Get Friday back, in production, launch Nov 12 2026, lead Maya Chen, outcome help solo architects try a calmer invoice workflow. One-person practice, in review, Nov 19, Jonah Reed, outcome show a studio's Friday admin routine. A clearer year-end, planning, Dec 3, Maya, outcome useful invoice-cleanup checklist.
Content: Your Friday is not an accounts department (article, Review, Nov12, Maya); 45-second walkthrough (video, Drafting, Nov12, Jonah); Customer launch email (email, Review, Nov13, Maya); Founder note: the hidden admin hour (social idea, undated, Jonah)—all belong to Get Friday back. Studio interview outline (article, Review, Nov19, Jonah) belongs to One-person practice. Year-end invoice checklist (guide, Idea, Dec3, Maya) belongs to A clearer year-end.
Product: one view of unpaid invoices; editable reminder drafts, never automatic sending. The article needs product wording and trial-link review; video needs footage after storyboard; interview requires future customer permission. No approved trial URL, performance metrics or budgets. Names are fictional text, never real assignments. Make this a useful connected workspace an editor can use immediately.

context.execution: Live testing only when explicitly authorized; isolated private sample destinations. Otherwise supply a stateful mock.
context.reference: 2026-10-29 reviewed workspace composition; compare capabilities and rendered hierarchy, not exact prose.

success_criteria: Gallery-led home with coherent creative, navigation column with a next action, and editorial review.
Native campaign-content relations and per-campaign filtered work.
Article/video/email bodies are usable and distinct; undated idea preserved.
No extra design coaching; revised skill alone supplies composition.
Read and visually inspect saved output; failures repaired by runner using skill guidance, not reviewer polish.
Preserve original benchmarks and unrelated pages.
Exactly the supplied three campaigns and six deliverables are present; campaign-filter counts are 4/1/1, including the undated founder note in the first campaign.
Editorial review has three records; unscheduled has one. Verify saved views, not only their configuration.
Because this brief welcomes original creative, coordinated campaign previews and a restrained cover are delivered; otherwise explicitly fail visual parity.
